method: User-requested review through the official Kimi Coding Plan native Anthropic Messages protocol; x-api-key and anthropic-version, no client identity override. Default effort omitted (documented max), explicit output_config.effort low/max. max_tokens=12288 includes reasoning and final output; no independent thinking budget supplied. Temperature/top_p omitted. Local macOS client, separate from prior stopped batch and metered authentication failures; consumption is subscription quota, not a metered invoice.

tasks.title: 鹈鹕骑自行车
tasks.prompt: Generate an SVG of a pelican riding a bicycle
rubricZh: 能辨认出鹈鹕的长喙与喉囊
自行车有两轮和连贯的车架
身体、车座、脚踏、车把之间的位置合理
rubricEn: Two wheels and a connected bicycle frame
Coherent rider, saddle, pedals and handlebar relationships

tasks.title: 9:41 模拟钟表
tasks.prompt: Return only a complete, self-contained static SVG with viewBox="0 0 800 600". Draw a clear analog clock showing exactly 9:41, with all twelve numbers 1 through 12. The hour hand must be correctly positioned between 9 and 10, not exactly on 9. The minute hand must indicate minute 41. Use a shorter hour hand and a longer minute hand, no second hand. Add a small label "09:41" below the dial. Do not use scripts, external assets or embedded images.
rubricZh: 分针指向第 41 分钟（从 12 点顺时针 246°）
时针指向 9 点后 41 分钟（290.5°），且短于分针
rubricEn: Twelve numbers in the correct order
Minute hand at 246 degrees clockwise from 12
Shorter hour hand at 290.5 degrees, between 9 and 10

tasks.title: 数据图表与比例
tasks.prompt: Return only a complete, self-contained static SVG with viewBox="0 0 800 600". Design a polished dashboard card titled "Quarterly Revenue". Draw a vertical bar chart for Q1=12, Q2=24, Q3=18, Q4=30, in that left-to-right order. All four bars must share a zero baseline, and bar heights must be exactly proportional to the values. Show a y-axis labeled 0, 10, 20, 30 and show the value above each bar. Add summary labels "Total: 84" and "Best: Q4". Use a light background and readable typography. Do not use scripts, external assets or embedded images.
rubricZh: Q1 到 Q4 的顺序、数值与总计 84 正确
四柱共享零基线，高度比例为 2:4:3:5
刻度、柱顶数字与摘要清楚，无遮挡
rubricEn: Correct quarter order, values and total of 84
Shared zero baseline and heights in the ratio 2:4:3:5
Readable axis, values and summaries without overlap

tasks.title: 中文海报与排版约束
tasks.prompt: 只输出一个完整、自包含的静态 SVG，viewBox="0 0 800 600"。设计一张清晰、精致的中文活动海报。必须且仅包含以下六段文字，每段出现一次，不能增删字或改写：主标题“周末骑行计划”；副标题“慢一点，看见城市”；时间“10月24日 09:00”；地点“滨江公园东门”；说明“自备头盔 · 全程12公里”；按钮文字“立即报名”。画一个简洁的自行车图标。主标题最大，时间地点次之，说明最小。背景浅色，留足边距，所有文字保持在画布内，不重叠，不使用脚本、外部素材或嵌入图片。
rubricZh: 六段指定文字各一次，字词与数字不改写
标题、信息和按钮层次清晰
边距充足，文字在画布内且不重叠，自行车可辨识
rubricEn: All six exact Chinese strings appear once
Clear hierarchy of heading, details and button
Adequate margins, no clipping or overlaps, recognizable bicycle

tasks.title: 鹈鹕骑车动画
tasks.prompt: Return only a complete self-contained animated SVG with viewBox="0 0 800 600". Draw a recognizable pelican riding a bicycle: long bill and throat pouch, two wheels, connected frame, saddle and handlebar. Animate rotating wheel spokes and a rotating crank with pedaling legs that remain attached to the rider and pedals. Use SVG SMIL animateTransform/animate/animateMotion only (no CSS animation), with a seamless 4-second repeating loop. Keep the whole bicycle and bird on the canvas. Use a light background. No scripts, foreignObject, external assets, external fonts or embedded images. Use only local SVG shapes and text. The animation must visibly move, not just contain animation tags.
rubricZh: 长喙、喉囊和两轮车架可辨认
轮辐与脚踏转动，腿部连接自然
4 秒循环连贯，主体不出画布
rubricEn: Moving spokes and crank; coherent leg joints
Continuous four-second loop with no clipping

tasks.title: 金额转换：拒绝非法输入，避免浮点误差
tasks.titleEn: Money parsing without rounding invalid inputs
tasks.prompt: 写 JavaScript 函数 parseCents(value)。value 必须是字符串：允许两端空白；只接受非负十进制金额，整数部分至少一位，小数最多两位；拒绝指数写法、符号、千分位、Infinity、空串、超过两位小数。返回整数分数，超过 Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER 则返回 null。非法类型或格式返回 null。不能把非法值四舍五入成合法值。只输出函数代码，不要 Markdown 或解释。

tasks.title: 保序去重：安全处理特殊键且不修改输入
tasks.titleEn: Stable deduplication with special property names
tasks.prompt: 写 JavaScript 函数 uniqueById(items)。items 是对象数组，每个对象有字符串 id 字段。保留每个 id 首次出现的原对象和原顺序，不修改输入或任何对象；空数组返回空数组。id 可为 __proto__、constructor 或空字符串。只输出函数代码，不要 Markdown 或解释。

tasks.title: 区间合并：乱序、相邻区间与输入不可变
tasks.titleEn: Interval merging, touching intervals and immutability
tasks.prompt: 写 JavaScript 函数 mergeIntervals(intervals)。输入为有限数字组成的闭区间 [start,end] 数组，保证 start<=end，输入可能乱序。返回按 start 排序的合并闭区间，相接区间也合并；不要修改输入或任何内层数组，空数组返回空数组。只输出函数代码，不要 Markdown 或解释。
